item.title: More than a decade ago, I sat down with @MarcMaron in his garage...
item.description: More than a decade ago, I sat down with @MarcMaron in his garage to tape something new called a podcast. This time, he came to me to record his last episode.We talked about the power of conviction, decency in an age of division, and the true story of America. I’ll miss Marc’s voice, but I hope his legacy of deep conversation and connection will continue.Listen to my conversation with Marc on the final episode of the WTF podcast at the link in my bio or wherever you get your podcasts.

item.title: MARC MARON'S ADVENTRES IN MOVIEGOING ️ In the latest episode o...
item.description: MARC MARON'S ADVENTRES IN MOVIEGOING ️ In the latest episode of our Criterion Channel original series the fearlessly unfiltered comedian and cultural commentator joins “The Ringer”’s Sean Fennessey for a discussion of his relationship to cinema, from childhood exposures to highly age-inappropriate films to his obsession with silent-movie stars to his evolving relationship with the French New Wave. Alongside their conversation, introduces a selection of art-house touchstones by Michelangelo Antonioni (RED DESERT), Wim Wenders (THE AMERICAN FRIEND), and Rainer Werner Fassbinder (VERONIKA VOSS), auteurs whose films he views as puzzles that continue to inspire questions and fascination even after multiple viewings.
